summary: Mrs. Hidary explores the themes of Parashat Vayetzeh, focusing on Yaakov's dream of the ladder and his journey from Be'er Shava to Charan. She discusses the four rungs of the ladder as a blueprint for personal growth and prayer, and examines the covenant of separation between Yaakov and Lavan at the end of the Parasha.
questions: Why did Yaakov leave Be'er Shava and head to Charan?
What do the four rungs of the ladder represent in our daily lives?
How does the story of the ladder relate to our morning prayers?
What is the difference between the Matzeva Yaakov built and the Gal Ed?
How does the Parasha teach us to navigate life in exile?
